ache.title: “Generous rewards” are bait with a bow on it
ache.note: The 2.5 program, walked through: Feixiao and Lingsha’s kits, banners for Robin, Kafka and Black Swan, and the ‘generous rewards’ in the patch. Free pulls feel like a gift, but they land right next to a stack of new banners. The gift is there to walk you to the banner screen.
ache.tip: Take the free stuff and only the free stuff. A real gift doesn’t come with homework.
lines: free pulls are the bakery’s free sample
Robin again? she’s fine without you
a gift that asks for more isn’t one

videoData.title: 2.5 Special Program Discussion | Honkai Star Rail

textData.text: In today's episode, we dive into the latest trailer revealing some exciting new features and characters. We start by discussing the Xianzhou Loufu filler arc, exploring its dynamic fighting gameplay and space-themed elements. We take a detailed look at the kits and abilities of upcoming characters like General Feixiao and Lingsha, their unique skills, and potential roles in combat. We also cover the banners and Light Cones for the new update, including Robin, Kafka, and Black Swan. Plus, we go over the generous rewards players can expect in the new patch. Join me as we analyze all the upcoming content and speculate on the best strategies for your account.
